title: F1F2 pilot telem.jsonl rows missing e2e hand/round telemetry
symptom: F1F2-PILOT-*.telem.jsonl had null upper_bonus_activation, round1_cleared false for all runs, and empty boss maps despite plausible max_round depth.
root_cause: Pilot batches completed on harness commit 7f59b1e before telem.jsonl aggregation matched live __GB_SIM_TELEM__ collection; jsonl reflected empty in-run telem while CSV outcomes were valid.
resolution: Rebuild telem sidecars with scripts/rebuild-telem-jsonl.cjs on measure branch (harness root + SIM_SCORING_VARIANT for Bp); leave pilot CSV append-only.
